items.item_text: 01. Information I provide to the following supplemental questions will be reviewed as part of the application process. Questions that are not fully and completely answered will be considered grounds for disqualification from the examination process. Stating "see resume" in lieu of a complete response to these questions is not acceptable. Select YES to indicate that you have read and understand these instructions. Options: Yes
02. Do you have a high school diploma or equivalent? Options: Yes | No
03. How many years of verifiable job related School Bus Driver experience do you have? Options: None | Less than 1 year | 1-2 years | 2-3 years | 3 years or more
04. How many years of verifiable job related experience do you have monitoring/controlling student passenger behavior? Options: None | Less than 1 year | 1-2 years | 2-3 years | 3 years or more
05. Do you have knowledge of safe driving practices and the provisions of the California Motor Vehicle Code applicable to school bus transportation? Options: Yes | No
06. Do you possess a valid Class A or B California Motor Vehicle Operator's license with passenger transportation endorsement, "S" and air brake endorsements? Options: Yes | No
07. Do you possess a valid California Special Driver Certificate for school buses? Options: Yes | No
08. Do you possess a valid California Highway Patrol approved First Aid Card? Options: Yes | No
09. Do you possess a valid Medical Examiner's Certificate, Form MCSA-5876? Options: Yes | No
10. Do you have a California DMV driving record report, dated within the last 30 days? Options: Yes | No

11. If you answered YES to the licenses and other requirements questions above, return to the main application in the attachments section and attach copies of your Class A or B California license, valid California Special Driver Certificate for school buses, First Aid Card, Medical Examiner's Certificate, and DMV printout (dated within the last 30 days). Please note, missing documents may be cause for disqualification. Select YES to indicate that you have read and understand these instructions. Options: Yes

12. According to the job announcement, check the box that most closely matches your level of proficiency to perform the minimum qualifications listed: Operate all types and sizes of buses with minimum notification and preparation time. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

13. Regularly perform trip validations, bus stop checks, gate, site, and field checks. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

14. Perform a variety of clerical and recordkeeping duties such as typing, filing, duplicating and distributing materials. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

15. Conduct safety inspections and perform routine preventive maintenance. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

16. Supervision and care of children of multiple ethnicities and cultural values, behavioral, and physical handicaps. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

17. Resolve conflict and maintain discipline of children on board busses. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

18. Read and interpret maps, compass directions, 24-hour clock time, schedules, manifests, and procedural instructions. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.
19. Describe your work related bus driving experience. In your answer, please provide specific examples of how you have shown flexibility and adaptability in your role.
20. Describe your experience performing clerical or recordkeeping duties. What types of records or reports were you responsible for?
21. Describe your experience working in a position that requires direct customer interaction.

Regularly perform full range of duties specified for school bus driver job class. Operate all types and sizes of school buses with minimum notification and preparation time in substitution for drivers of regularly scheduled routes; operate all types and sizes of district school buses on runs as requested by dispatch staff, including demand/response trips during traditional and nontraditional workdays and work hours. Regularly perform trip validations, bus stop checks, gate, site, and field checks, equipment transfers and shuttles, bus safety education presentations to pupils, driver assistance for non-police emergencies, inspection assistance for bus cleanliness and body condition, and inventory assistance for safety and accessory components on district. Prepare and submit reports identifying discrepancies in equipment, manifests, stops, routing, and scheduling conditions when substituting for other drivers. Provide mentoring with their specific knowledge on driving techniques and strategies to school bus drivers as assigned. Complete and submit field trip reports; collect and submit other data on school bus operations as assigned; maintain effective, professional working relationships with parents, pupils, District and contract carrier staffs, and the public. Regularly attend and/or participate in mandated instruction/training classes for specialized driving skills during traditional and nontraditional workdays and work hours; may wash bus exteriors, may fuel and provide minor service to vehicles; may maintain general orderliness and parking organization of depots. May cover regular routes for employees on extended leave. May provide relief for dispatchers, radio, and telephone operators as needed. Perform a variety of clerical and recordkeeping duties associated with position, including typing, filing, duplicating and distributing materials. Prepare and maintain files and records; review and verify for accuracy and completeness. Prepare, maintain and distribute a variety of logs, records and files related to transportation; assist bus drivers with the accurate completion of required reports in a timely manner. Operate a variety of office equipment including a copier, fax machine, computer and applicable software applications . Perform related duties as assigned. KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES: KNOWLEDGE OF: Safe and defensive driving practices. Proper operations of school buses. Applicable traffic and student transportation laws, codes and regulations. Basic first aid procedures. Basic record-keeping and report preparation techniques. Interpersonal skills using tact, patience and courtesy. Health and safety regulations. Operate a variety of office equipment including a computer and applicable software applications. Oral and written communication skills. Laws and regulations governing pupil transportation. Geography, topology, and traffic patterns of the district. Sufficient verbal and written skills to effectively communicate via two-way radio and in preparing written reports. ABILITY TO: Conduct safety inspections and perform routine preventive maintenance and maintain bus in clean and proper working condition. Administer first aid. Operate a two-way radio. Perform a variety of clerical and recordkeeping duties associated with position. Maintain routine records. Operate all types and sizes of school buses safely and on a specified time schedule in varied and complex topographical, weather, urban traffic, rural and mountain terrain conditions. Communicate effectively and maintain cooperative relationships. Show personality and character traits suited to supervision and care of children of multiple ethnicities and cultural values, behavioral, and physical handicaps. Resolve conflict and maintain discipline of children on board buses. Read and interpret maps, compass directions, 24-hour clock time, schedules, manifests, and procedural instructions. Rapidly learn routes with short notice and the operation of equipment related to duties. WORKING CONDITIONS: ENVIRONMENT: Driving in varied and complex topographical, weather, urban traffic, rural and mountain terrain conditions School bus and outdoor environment Seasonal heat and cold or adverse weather conditions Exposure to fumes, dust, odors and oil/grease Evening or variable hours Driving a vehicle to conduct work PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Hearing and speaking to exchange information. Seeing to read a variety of materials, monitor drivers and observe hazards. Sitting or standing for extended periods of time. Bending at the waist, kneeling or crouching to inspect buses, and reaching overhead, above the shoulders and horizontally. Climbing ladders or steps. Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate equipment. Lifting moderately heavy children or objects. HAZARDS: Traffic hazards Driving a vehicle during adverse weather conditions Working at heights while inspecting and cleaning the buses Fumes from chemical cleansers and bus operation
Must have a current California Department of Motor Vehicles K-4 printout to be submitted with the job application.
